name: Boolean cut: bracket plate 80 × 50 × 15 mm with a through bolt hole r8 mm
notes: The archetypal consumer part: a plate with a drilled hole. The cut subtracts the tool cylinder from the target plate and consumes both bodies; only the bracket remains. Geometry: plate spans x[-40,40] y[-25,25] z[0,15]; hole cylinder axis at (15,0) spans z[-5,20], overshooting the plate on both sides so the hole is a clean through-bore with no coplanar cap faces. Analytic derivation: volume = plateV - bore = 80*50*15 - pi*8^2*15 = 60000 - 960*pi; surface = plate surface - two hole discs + bore lateral = 11900 - 128*pi + 240*pi = 11900 + 112*pi; center of mass x = -pi*8^2*15*15 / (60000 - 960*pi) (removed material sat at x = 15), y = 0, z = 7.5. Topology verified against pinned OCCT V8_0_0_p1: 7 faces (6 plate faces, top and bottom each carrying the hole loop, + bore lateral with seam), 15 edges (12 plate + 2 hole circles + seam line), 10 vertices (8 plate + 2 seam endpoints).
